_note: Structure-function (expression) validation inputs — see docs/expression-validation.md. GENCODE genes (TSS) + ENCODE RNA-seq gene quantifications + ChromHMM 15-state segmentation (active-region filter AND enhancer states). Enhancers: EnhancerAtlas's host is currently down (404/502); the chromHMM Enh/EnhG states serve as enhancers by default. To use EnhancerAtlas or ENCODE cCRE instead, add an entry like {"name":"enhancers","source":"url","url":"<EnhancerAtlas GM12878 bed>"} (may need --insecure) or resolve an ENCODE cCRE bed (e.g. annotation ENCSR398LKB). Fetch: python -m validation fetch --manifest validation/manifests/GM12878_expression.json --out data/_expr
